description:
Today, automate_release.py:run_ci_checks runs lint, format, type-check,
and fast tests at release time. That makes "release" the first time any
CI failure surfaces - turning a publication event into a debugging
session. Goal: CI becomes ambient. Every push to main and every PR runs
the same checks. main is always green; release never re-runs CI.

Once continuous CI is in place, the release-time CI gate in
automate_release.py is dead code (and gets deleted in Phase 6).

Under Option B, this workflow file is added on private and lands on
public via the Phase 4 final sync (alongside everything else). The
no-op verification commit happens on public after Phase 4. Branch
protection is configured in Phase 5 once dev locus is on the public
clone.

Plan file: /Users/joe/.claude/plans/single-repo-migration.md (Phase 2).

anti_patterns.dont: add new test categories or coverage thresholds
anti_patterns.why: the goal is parity with today's release-time CI, not to expand it; raise the bar in a separate item if needed.

anti_patterns.dont: remove run_ci_checks from automate_release.py in this phase
anti_patterns.why: the release pipeline is still in use; removing the gate before ambient CI is proven creates a window of no checks at all.
YAML workflow changes that never run are a known footgun; only a real run proves the syntax and triggers are correct.

preserves.behavior: Test execution order or markers are not changed; only WHEN the tests run changes.
The exclusion list (PySpark tests etc.) matches automate_release.py exactly so behaviour is consistent across both gates during the transition.
automate_release.py is unchanged in this phase; its run_ci_checks still runs at release time. Removing it from the release path is Phase 6.

verifications.description: CI workflow file exists and runs all four checks
CI workflow triggers on push and pull_request
Workflow runs green on a no-op commit

work_units.notes:
ls .github/workflows/
Identify which workflow currently runs lint+tests (likely test.yml or
similar). Read it. Note which checks it already runs and on which
triggers.

Triggers: push to main, pull_request to main.
Jobs (mirror automate_release.py:582-608):
  1. uv run ruff check .
  2. uv run ruff format --check .
  3. uv run ty check
  4. uv run -- python -m pytest -m "fast and not (slow or stress or
     resource_heavy or live_integration)" --cov=benchbox
     --cov-fail-under=70 --ignore=tests/unit/platforms/dataframe/test_pyspark_df.py
     --ignore=tests/unit/platforms/pyspark
Use ubuntu-latest. Set up uv via astral-sh/setup-uv@v3.
Cache uv dependencies for speed.
work_units.summary: Extend or create a CI workflow that runs the four release-time checks

  on the private repo. Not a regression in code or workflow YAML.
  Phase 5 retires the private clone; failures self-resolve.

  repo running the same content green).
- Trigger amendment (push to develop, v*; PRs to main, develop)
  cannot be exercised until develop and v* exist, which is Phase 4.

When Phase 4 creates develop on public and pushes the first commit,
the test.yml + lint.yml workflows will fire on develop for the
first time — that is the actual verification of this work unit.
Phase 4 w3-equivalent verification picks it up.

work_units.notes:
Branch protection cannot be tested against a private repo without
affecting the maintainer's own pushes. Record the intended settings
so they can be applied in Phase 5 without re-deciding:
  - Require PR before merging
  - Require status checks to pass: select the CI workflow from w2
  - Require linear history
  - Allow squash-merge only (disable merge commits and rebase-merge)
  - Block force pushes
  - Block deletions
Solo maintainer note: do NOT require approving review (you would
block yourself).
work_units.summary: Document branch protection settings in decisions doc (apply in Phase 5)
